definitions.gloss: theft of unattended belongings; baggage theft
definitions.explanation: The act of stealing someone's belongings that have been left unattended, such as bags at a train station, restaurant, or other public place. A common type of petty crime in urban areas.

examples.japanese: {置|お}き{引|び}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please watch out for theft of unattended belongings.
I was a victim of baggage theft at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}さない→離す：19372_hanasu⟧ようにしない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{置|お}き{引|び}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't keep your eyes on your luggage at the airport, there's a chance of having it stolen.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{置|お}き→置く：01092_oku⟧ (leaving, from ⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧) and {引|ひ}き (pulling/taking, from ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧). Literally "pulling away what has been left." This refers specifically to opportunistic theft of bags and belongings left momentarily unattended.

- {置|お}き{引|び}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be a victim of baggage theft
